title: Rollo and S Visit

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Mr Calhoun sends his Regards. With a capital R. Not warm regards. Just “Regards”. You know what that means?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr Calhoun sends his Regards. With a capital R. Not warm regards. Just “Regards”. You know what that means?

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: It means he is planning which of your limbs to remove first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It means he is planning which of your limbs to remove first.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: You'll pay him now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll pay him now.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: We are brothers. Standard Security 8-Series models. Stop attempting to distract me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We are brothers. Standard Security 8-Series models. Stop attempting to distract me.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: We used to work at CorpSec HQ. Until we were fired when the 9 series was introduced. Mr Calhoun gave us a break and-- damn! Stop this distraction technique.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We used to work at CorpSec HQ. Until we were fired when the 9 series was introduced. Mr Calhoun gave us a break and-- damn! Stop this distraction technique.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: ... what do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... what do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: There is no contest between egg forms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is no contest between egg forms.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: I am not paid to discuss eggs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not paid to discuss eggs.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: It's true that I suffer from brow-strain. The doctor said I should relax my face more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's true that I suffer from brow-strain. The doctor said I should relax my face more.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Twenty-four.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Twenty-four.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Some days I can't even find the energy to crush a soda can in a menacing fashion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some days I can't even find the energy to crush a soda can in a menacing fashion.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: He needs dermis treatment on his knuckles from all the beatings but Mr Calhoun won’t let him wear the moisturizing gloves on duty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He needs dermis treatment on his knuckles from all the beatings but Mr Calhoun won’t let him wear the moisturizing gloves on duty.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: He gave us a chance when no one else would.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He gave us a chance when no one else would.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: You mean like the bailiff business? There aren’t many openings. The battering ram bots keep close ranks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean like the bailiff business? There aren’t many openings. The battering ram bots keep close ranks.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: For you? As what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For you? As what?

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Security? You mean like, doormen? Bouncers? Chuckers-Out? Stand in one place and look menacing, rather than tramping all over the city?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Security? You mean like, doormen? Bouncers? Chuckers-Out? Stand in one place and look menacing, rather than tramping all over the city?

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: We couldn't. Mr Calhoun...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We couldn't. Mr Calhoun...

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: As far as I know, he only cares for two things: money and fishing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As far as I know, he only cares for two things: money and fishing.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: I must tell Rollo about this!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I must tell Rollo about this!

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: As are you. With your debt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As are you. With your debt.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: Your attempt to alter the topic is painfully obvious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your attempt to alter the topic is painfully obvious.

nodes.speaker: Sanderson
nodes.text: I am not paid to discuss tortoises.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not paid to discuss tortoises.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He likes me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He likes me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll pay him eventually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll pay him eventually.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's never getting that money back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's never getting that money back.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's never getting that money back.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's never getting that money back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you and Rollo twins?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you and Rollo twins?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok, OK! I'm going!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, OK! I'm going!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you come to be working for Calhoun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you come to be working for Calhoun?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you come to be working for Calhoun?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you come to be working for Calhoun?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems like you're underpaid to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems like you're underpaid to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seems like you're underpaid to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seems like you're underpaid to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which do you prefer, poached eggs or scrambled?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which do you prefer, poached eggs or scrambled?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Which do you prefer, poached eggs or scrambled?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Which do you prefer, poached eggs or scrambled?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So scrambled, then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So scrambled, then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It can’t be easy, pounding the streets, threatening people, looking menacing all day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It can’t be easy, pounding the streets, threatening people, looking menacing all day.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It can’t be easy, pounding the streets, threatening people, looking menacing all day.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It can’t be easy, pounding the streets, threatening people, looking menacing all day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How many people are you intimidating right now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How many people are you intimidating right now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How many people are you intimidating right now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How many people are you intimidating right now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It sounds exhausting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds exhausting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How about Rollo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about Rollo?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Calhoun doesn’t sound like a very good employer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Calhoun doesn’t sound like a very good employer.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Calhoun doesn’t sound like a very good employer.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Calhoun doesn’t sound like a very good employer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you considered other career options?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you considered other career options?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you considered other career options?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you considered other career options?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Guess you're stuck then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess you're stuck then.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How about working for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about working for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don’t know. Security maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t know. Security maybe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Exactly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let me worry about Calhoun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me worry about Calhoun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There must be some way to win him over.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There must be some way to win him over.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There must be some way to win him over.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There must be some way to win him over.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Leave it with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Leave it with me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You are in a desert walking along in the sand when all of sudden you look down ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are in a desert walking along in the sand when all of sudden you look down ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You are in a desert walking along in the sand when all of sudden you look down ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You are in a desert walking along in the sand when all of sudden you look down ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... and you see a tortoise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... and you see a tortoise.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For example.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For example.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fishing, interesting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fishing, interesting.
